risk_related_new_disclosures.value: The Q2 2026 Form 10-Q states that, other than the noted financing-covenant update, risk factors had not materially changed from the FY2025 Form 10-K.

The Q2 2026 Form 10-Q adds/updates the restrictive-covenant risk for the new Senior Unsecured Revolving Credit Facility and Senior Notes. The revolver requires a maximum consolidated net-debt-to-EBITDA ratio of 4.00:1.00, with an optional 4.50:1.00 step-up for four fiscal quarters after a qualifying acquisition involving at least $750 million of cash consideration, subject to conditions.
As of June 30, 2026, outstanding bank guarantees and bonds totaled $304.8 million; the company states these instruments can require customer payments for non-performance.
risk_related_new_disclosures.original_location: Note 13 - Commitments and Contingencies / Bank Guarantees and Bonds

risk_related_new_disclosures.value: Vertiv initiated claims for refunds of certain IEEPA tariffs after a 2026 court process, but states that the amount, timing and likelihood of any recovery remain uncertain and any refund may be less than the full amount paid.

acquisitions_and_portfolio_events.value: PurgeRite acquisition closed December 4, 2025. Total consideration transferred was $1,138.3 million net of $14.4 million cash acquired; gross consideration was $1,152.7 million, comprising $1,003.5 million cash, $139.2 million contingent consideration and $10.0 million other. Additional contingent cash consideration can be up to $250.0 million if specified performance metrics are achieved.

At June 30, 2026, the recorded PurgeRite contingent earnout liability was $206.1 million. Vertiv recognized contingent-consideration fair-value losses of $28.8 million in Q2 2026 and $62.0 million in H1 2026.

acquisitions_and_portfolio_events.value: At the approximately $1.45 billion upfront purchase price, Vertiv states the UIG acquisition represents approximately 13x expected UIG 2027 EBITDA.
